Which imputation a layer gets when the caller does not say

Source: R/qc-imputation.R
resolve_impute_method.Rd

Proteomics gets MinProb; anything counted gets none. Mirrors how run_qc() already resolves outlier_method per omics type, and for the same reason: the right answer differs by measurement, and a single global default is wrong for one of them whichever it is.

Usage

resolve_impute_method(omics_type)

Arguments

omics_type

Modality string.

Value

A single method name.

See also

Other qc: IMPUTE_METHOD_ASSUMPTION, impute_matrix(), plot_qc(), qc_depth(), qc_depth_outliers(), qc_missingness(), qc_outliers(), run_qc(), winsorize_counts()
